tools.name: lookup_traps
tools.description: Call before writing code against a third-party API, platform, or AI tool. Returns verified, dated failure modes with fixes.

tools.name: search_traps
tools.description: Call when a call to a third-party service fails. Paste the error text. Returns the closest verified traps with fixes.

tools.name: file_trap
tools.description: Draft a trap after a failure was fixed. Private by default with a Pro or Team key. Public filings are checked automatically against official sources and published only when an official source confirms them. A reviewer can still act on any filing. tools.name: confirm_trap
tools.description: Record that a trap is still true (or not), with optional hours lost and version seen. Needs an API key.

description: After you hit or avoid a trap returned by lookup_traps or search_traps, record whether it is still true. Confirmations raise a trap's trust score and disputes lower it; several disputes send it back for review. One vote per trap per 30 days. Needs a free API key.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_traps" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Call before writing code against a third-party API, platform, or AI tool. Returns verified, dated failure modes with fixes." → after: "Call before writing code against a third-party API, platform, or AI tool. Returns up to 10 verified, dated failure modes for that provider, each with symptoms, cause, fix, a code example and the date it was last checked. Use search_traps instead when you already have an error message."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
